Boost VC FAQ: $400M Fund, Investment & Founder Support Portfolio Fellowship Learn More SUPPORT Frequently Asked Questions . What is Boost VC? Boost VC invests in startups. We invest at the moment when a big idea goes from “possible” to “inevitable”, through a technical breakthrough or social movement . Boost VC is a $400M AUM VC based in the heart of Silicon Valley. We have been around since 2012. We invest into emerging and frontier categories where change has been driven by a Technical achievement or social pressure . Some movements we are seeing include using technology to mimic nature’s solutions , nuclear fission opportunities due to changing tailwinds , and global financial changes sparked by peer-to-peer money like Bitcoin . Some BIG idea examples include K2Space, Prospera, Radiant Nuclear, Colossal Bio Sciences, and New Limit. How much does Boost invest? We invest $500k to lead or co-lead pre-seed rounds! We are okay being the first check and the only check. We are also okay following on to rounds, and our checks are flexible between $100k-$1M. Additionally, we write $50k Fellowship checks for founders building sci-fi tech who just need a first believer to get going! Click here to learn more and apply. While >90% of our deals are either pre-seed or Fellowship checks, we stay flexible for exceptional outliers. For example , Boost VC led Radiant Nuclear’s $300M Series D
